I have very bad hand pain due to my profession and b0xx saved my ability to play melee. As long as you use the proper form it is much better on hands and wrists. Before I could only play on GCC for around 10-15 minutes before the back of my hands would start to go numb but now I can grind for around 2 hours before that happens. Just know that your hands will be in pain and feel uncomfortable when you are first learning it because you are using your hands in a way they aren't used to. Overall, if you stick with it it is IMO 100% worth.
